summary: Yahweh says to Joshua see I have given Jericho into hand and king and mighty men, you shall march around city all men of war once a day six days, seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams horns before ark, seventh day march around seven times priests blow trumpets, when you hear trumpet blast all people shout with great shout, wall will fall flat, people shall go up every man straight ahead. Joshua commands, priests trumpets, armed men before ark, rear guard after ark, rest walk, no shout until day Joshua says shout. Six days once around. Seventh day rose early, marched seven times, seventh time priests blew, Joshua says shout Yahweh has given city, city shall be devoted, only Rahab and all in house shall live because hid messengers, keep from devoted thing lest make camp accursed. Under oath: cursed before Yahweh man who builds Jericho, with loss firstborn shall lay foundation, with youngest set up gates. Israel shouts, wall falls flat, go up straight ahead take city, devoted all man woman young old ox sheep donkey with edge of sword, only Rahab brought out, burned city with fire, Rahab lives to this day. So Yahweh was with Joshua, fame in all land.
whyItMatters: Iconic battle — victory by obedience and shouting, not siege engines. Shows devoted thing (cherem), Rahab's faith, and curse of rebuilding (fulfilled in 1 Kings 16:34 Hiel rebuilds at cost of sons).

keyVerses.text: At the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for Yahweh has given you the city!
keyVerses.why: Shout before wall falls — faith declaration.

keyVerses.text: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.
keyVerses.why: Trumpet plus shout plus faith — wall falls flat under itself.

keyVerses.text: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
keyVerses.why: Rahab lives — faith from previous chapter rewarded.

questions.question: Why march around, trumpets, shout? Military strategy?
questions.answer: Not conventional siege — no rams, ladders. Seven priests, seven trumpets (shofar rams horns), ark, marching, silence until shout. Liturgical procession around city like bringing God's presence around. Seventh day seven times, trumpets long blast, great shout. Wall fell flat under itself (tachat — beneath). Emphasis: victory by divine action through obedience and faith, not might. Procession may have been to give time for Rahab to be noted and to symbolize dedicating city as firstfruits devoted.

questions.question: What does devoted, ban, cherem mean? Why kill all?
questions.answer: Hebrew cherem — devoted to destruction, set apart to Yahweh, not for human use. Jericho as first city of land is firstfruits devoted. In ancient Near Eastern warfare, cities devoted to deity to show war is God's. Troubling to modern readers — man woman young old ox sheep donkey with edge sword. Text presents as divine judgment on Canaanite practices (Deut says abominations). Keep yourselves from devoted thing lest make camp accursed — warning Achan next chapter takes devoted thing and brings trouble. Rahab exception shows faith spares.

questions.question: Why only Rahab saved?
questions.answer: Rahab prostitute (zonah) who hid spies and said Yahweh your God he is God in heaven above and earth beneath (2:11). Her faith and action — hid messengers, tied scarlet cord — matches Israel's faith. Joshua said only Rahab and all in her house live. She lives in Israel to this day — note indicates later editing, but shows prostitute Gentile included and even in Matthew 1 genealogy ancestor of David and Jesus. From devoted city, one family devoted in different sense — saved alive.

questions.question: What is curse who rebuilds Jericho with firstborn and youngest?
questions.answer: Verse 26: cursed before Yahweh man who rises builds Jericho, with loss of firstborn lay foundation, youngest set up gates — building will cost children. Fulfilled in 1 Kings 16:34 Hiel Bethelite built Jericho, laid foundation at cost of Abiram firstborn, set up gates at cost of Segub youngest. Shows word stands long after. City remained ruins for centuries, mound, not rebuilt as fortified city until later.

glossary.def: Set apart to Yahweh for destruction, not for human use — firstfruits of land.
Trumpets of jubilee, used for signal, worship, war cry.
Editorial note — prostitute now lives in Israel, ancestor of David, included.
